MEM: M_t=rho*M_(t-1)+(1-rho)*P_t; feature=M_(t-1); initialize first valid month M=P; 24 prior valid months required; reset on gap; no Q state updates
SL: C0+PT+beta_L*z(L1)+gamma*I_cold*z(L1); one extra beta, no extra month intercept
validation: next two full calendar years; no random splits; common support for all five models
inner: three expanding blocks cutoffs outer-6,-4,-2; next two years, >=8 complete training years; all transforms refit per block
fallback: reject coverage-failed fold before scoring; minimum3 outer folds per station and20 stations for promotion; no score-based dropping
selection: mean inner block raw MSE; best mean plus its sample SE; largest eligible alpha; MEM tie choose smallest eligible rho at that alpha
primary: station equal mean MSE_skill vs newly fitted P2-L1 on same outer months
historical_exposed_comparison: only globally promoted new candidates, final models frozen first, predictions sealed without Q, separate scorer later; POST_HOC_EXPOSED_2018_2020_NOT_BLIND
exposure: P6D retrospective diagnoses informed these model choices; <=2017 historical prior experiments also exposed; CV is developmental evidence not final independent confirmation
training_label_role: original public LamaH Q only, never P6/eHYD/teacher Q
